sources_tried: Seed file research/installers/raw/seeds/orlando.json: worked. It had 43 maps results and no web results. Relevant: Associated Building Specialties, Florida Specialty Products, Interior Specialties, Mills & Nebraska. American Sanitary Partition (Ocoee) is a toilet compartment manufacturer (Yellow Pages: founded 1932) and was skipped as a manufacturer plant; its site returned 503. The rest were remodelers and stores.
Bobrick find-a-rep (bobrick.com/find-a-rep): fetched but no results without the dropdown (JS). No reps read.
Bradley find-a-rep: page returned no content.
Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco/Ammco locators: not tried (time and fetch budget).
The Blue Book: search page and iProView profile returned 403 (blocked).

Procore Network: worked. The FL and Orlando 'toilet-bath-and-laundry-accessories' category pages and profiles (Florida Division 10, Aletheia, N4 Construction, Ace Relocation, ProGlobalBusinessSolutions, Warlord) loaded. The 'toilet-compartments' URL returned an unrelated generic list.
BBB category pages (Oviedo and Clermont 'partition'): worked. Hufcor Florida Group (Sanford) is operable walls only, so excluded.
Yellow Pages Orlando 'commercial bathroom partitions': worked, but mostly irrelevant listings.
MapQuest listing (phoenix-integration.aws.mapquest.com): host blocked by session network (ENOTFOUND).
WebSearch: used all 8 calls. Most useful: 'Division 10 specialties contractor Orlando toilet compartments...' (extended) and 'restroom partitions installer Orlando ... Kissimmee Sanford' (extended).

Excluded as out of area: Bell Architectural Specialties (Riverview FL, installs toilet partitions, serves Orlando, 813-741-9926), Spec10 Solutions (Florida-wide, base not stated, Miami phone), Restroom Stalls and All (Gainesville GA dealer; its own W2 crews install in Orlando; no local base), Unified Door & Hardware Group (NJ), Square 10 Source (Plant City).
Unverified lead: Top Line Partitions, Inc. (Oviedo), mentioned only in a search summary. No page about it was read, so it is not listed.

candidates.name: Florida Division 10, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists Toilet Partitions among installed specialties; install-only ('WE DO NOT FURNISH', per-piece quotes). Projects page lists 22 Central Florida jobs (Kissimmee, Orlando, Apopka, Sanford) but none name partitions.
candidates.reason: Install-only Division 10 subcontractor in Orlando that lists toilet partitions and works for GCs. It doesn't supply products, so the buy-around risk is low and it's a good fit.
